How do the Venue and Identity refactors unify Clean Architecture, AstraFlow 2.3.0, and 3-DB concurrency?

Long image

A

Answer

Venue, Identity, Core, and Frontend Profile pass every Clean Architecture, AstraFlow 2.3.0, and 3-provider concurrency gate with 100/100 module scores.1

  1. Domain hardening moved Court, CourtCluster, FacilityModel, SignupSession, TenantThemeFavorite, and NotificationPreference onto AuditableEntity<Guid> with encapsulated collections.2
  2. Compile-time [AstraGenerateMapping] bridges retired IdentityConventionProfile and nine legacy Venue rule files while removing EF Core from Identity.Application.3
  3. Three-provider migrations added 19 Identity and Core RowVersion tokens plus Venue GuestReservationAccess and IdempotencyReceipts across 54 total migrations.4
  4. Frontend profile carries rowVersion end-to-end, clears stale TanStack Query caches on HTTP 409, and passes 24 of 24 scoped tests.5

Applies toVenue + Identity + Core + Profile (3-DB)

1

How do Frontend Profile, AstraFlow 2.3.0, and 3-DB modules connect?

Diagram structure
  • Profile MVVM Hooks fe_profile
  • Sealed Controllers api_gw
  • AstraFlow Pipeline med_pipe
  • Module Receipt Store idem_store
  • Venue & Identity App venue_app
  • MapModel & Converters map_gen
  • BaseDb & Module DBs ef_ctx
  • SQL, Oracle, Postgres db_providers
  • fe_profile → api_gw · rowVersion PUT
  • api_gw → med_pipe · ICommand & Clamp
  • med_pipe → idem_store · receipt lease
  • med_pipe → venue_app · Result<T>
  • venue_app → map_gen · MapModel
  • venue_app → ef_ctx · pure domain
  • ef_ctx → db_providers · 54 migrations
  1. Frontend Profile MVVM ↗

    ProfileMapper, SovereignAccountRepository, and useProfileDossierViewModel forward rowVersion and trigger conflict cache invalidation on HTTP 409.

  2. Sealed Endpoints & Clamping ↗

    Venue and Identity controllers are sealed partial classes under 300 lines with Math.Clamp pagination limits (<= 100) and ToIdempotent*Result adapters.

  3. AstraFlow Mediator & Idempotency ↗

    All mutating handlers implement ICommand (never IQuery), register IInvalidatesCache, and claim receipts via AddModuleReceiptContext<VenueDbContext>("Venue").

  4. Decoupled Application & Mapping ↗

    EF Core was removed from Identity.Application.csproj; [AstraGenerateMapping] bridges entities through flat *MapModel types with [AstraSensitive] and IdentityGuid.

  5. Dual-Mode 3-Provider Persistence ↗

    IdentityDbContext enforces HasMaxLength(16) concurrency tokens and BaseDbContext rotates RowVersion across SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.

How do optimistic concurrency and ADR-040 receipts run end-to-end?

Diagram structure
  • Profile ViewModel fe
  • TanStack Cache tq
  • Sealed Controller ctrl
  • AstraFlow + Idem app
  • 3-DB Contexts db
  • fe → ctrl · PUT dossier/preferences + rowVersion
  • ctrl → app · Dispatch Update Command (Result<T>)
  • app → db · Compare RowVersion + AdvanceRowVersion()
  • db → app · DbUpdateConcurrencyException (stale)
  • app → ctrl · Conflict Result (409)
  • ctrl → fe · HTTP 409 ProblemDetails
  • fe → tq · invalidateOnConcurrencyConflict()
  • ctrl → app · ConfirmReservationCommand + IdempotencyKey
  • app → db · TX 1 claim venue.IdempotencyReceipts
  • app → db · TX 2 save entity + AdvanceRowVersion
  • app → ctrl · ToIdempotentCreatedResult (201)

Why route stale profile writes to HTTP 409 instead of swallowing failures?

Previously useWorkstationPreferencesViewModel swallowed rejections while backend Identity entities omitted concurrency columns. Pairing IConcurrencyAwareEntity.AdvanceRowVersion() with isConcurrencyConflictError guarantees conflicts fail safely and trigger a fresh TanStack refetch.5

Which architectural trade-offs shaped the final implementation?

Architectural DecisionChosen ImplementationRejected AlternativeTrade-Off & Guarantee
AstraFlow AFM001 Inheritance ConstraintCompile-time C#Flat sealed *MapModel (System.Object) + [AstraValueConverter] bridgeKeep reflection IdentityConventionProfile or loosen analyzer rulesAdds small projection classes per aggregate while eliminating all runtime reflection.
Cross-DB Optimistic ConcurrencyIdentical on 3 DBsIConcurrencyAwareEntity.AdvanceRowVersion() with HasMaxLength(16).ValueGeneratedNeverRely on database IsRowVersion() across PostgreSQLPostgreSQL bytea rowVersion: true lacks auto-increment without triggers; BaseDbContext rotates GUID tokens on all 3 engines.
Oracle Schema ResolutionStays in VENUECanonical 1-arg ToTable("GuestReservationAccesses")Hardcoded 2-arg schema strings (ToTable(name, "venue"))Avoids Oracle case-sensitive lowercase schema drift and matches sibling Venue entity configurations.
Venue ADR-040 IdempotencyDurable 3-TXAddModuleReceiptContext<VenueDbContext>("Venue") + UsesModuleReceiptStore => trueCustom ad-hoc BookingIdempotencyRecords handler loopsStandardizes 2-minute leases, ToIdempotent*Result adapters, and IdempotencyMigrationPresenceTests coverage (18/18).
Strict <= 300L Decomposition0 FILE-EXCEPTIONsealed partial feature/handler splits + typed Result errorsRetaining // FILE-EXCEPTION waivers in large handlers/seedersKeeps every single class and controller concise while preserving namespace compatibility and testability.
